related.title: Linux 排程：公平份額與等待延遲
related.titleEn: Linux scheduling: fair shares and waiting latency
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付相依圖、關鍵路徑表及循環反例；不直接更改主機服務。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the dependency graph, critical-path table and cycle counterexample without changing host services. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 先以六個100 ms代幣分配1:2:3，再細分時間片；記錄每工作CPU累計與最長等待。
related.differenceEn: Allocate six hundred-millisecond tokens at1:2:3, then subdivide slices; log per-job CPU totals and longest waits.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
啟動排序與需求相依是不同關係；After排序不單獨表示拉起服務。ready訊號也不同於程序已產生。
本課數值核對：4+2+1 = 7 s；另一項核對：max(7,3) = 7 s。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

公平份額可用權重建立簡化模型；實際Linux排程版本另有機制，不能把理想份額當保證延遲。
本課數值核對：600*3/(1+2+3) = 300 ms；另一項核對：600*6/(1+2+6) = 400 ms。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Ordering and requirement dependencies are distinct; After alone does not pull in a service. Readiness differs from merely spawning a process.
Numeric audit: 4+2+1 = 7 s; second audit: max(7,3) = 7 s. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Weights define a simplified fair-share model; actual Linux scheduler versions have additional mechanisms, so ideal share is not a latency guarantee.
Numeric audit: 600*3/(1+2+3) = 300 ms; second audit: 600*6/(1+2+6) = 400 ms. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Linux namespace：PID 視角與隔離範圍
related.titleEn: Linux namespaces: PID views and isolation scope
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付相依圖、關鍵路徑表及循環反例；不直接更改主機服務。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver the dependency graph, critical-path table and cycle counterexample without changing host services. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 以穩定物件ID連接host與child PID，列每個視角能看到的祖先及子孫；另列隔離維度矩陣。
related.differenceEn: Join host/child PIDs by stable object identity, list visible ancestry and descendants, and build an isolation-dimension matrix.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
啟動排序與需求相依是不同關係；After排序不單獨表示拉起服務。ready訊號也不同於程序已產生。
本課數值核對：4+2+1 = 7 s；另一項核對：max(7,3) = 7 s。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

namespace改變資源名稱與觀察視角；PID隔離不自動包含檔案、網路、權限及資源配額隔離。
本課數值核對：3*2 = 6 names；另一項核對：3+1 = 4 processes。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Ordering and requirement dependencies are distinct; After alone does not pull in a service. Readiness differs from merely spawning a process.
Numeric audit: 4+2+1 = 7 s; second audit: max(7,3) = 7 s. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Namespaces change names and observation contexts; PID isolation alone does not isolate files, networks, privileges or quotas.
Numeric audit: 3*2 = 6 names; second audit: 3+1 = 4 processes. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
